resolution_notes: Disputed free_tier_limits: both verifiers flagged incorrect but offered near-paraphrases of the original. Official JSON API docs (aqicn.org/json-api/doc/) state free token access and the published default quota of 1,000 requests per second; commercial/for-profit use needs agreement (token page). Kept substantive original; minor wording cleanup only if needed for fidelity to docs. Disputed rate_limits: Verifier A confirmed original; Verifier B marked incorrect with almost identical text. Docs support "1,000 requests per second" default quota and contact for higher limits — original stands. Automated base_url HTTP 0 is treated as bot/network false positive: docs_url HTTP 200, same project, and feed endpoints are documented on api.waqi.info; status remains operational. Evidence: https://aqicn.org/json-api/doc/ , https://aqicn.org/data-platform/token/
